facts.fact: ACOS (advertising cost of sales) is ad spend divided by ad-attributed sales, expressed as a percentage
facts.quote: ACOS, or advertising cost of sales, is ad spend divided by ad-attributed sales, expressed as a percentage

facts.fact: ACOS example: spending 200 rupees to get 1000 rupees of attributed sales results in 20% ACOS
facts.quote: Spend 200 rupees, get 1000 rupees of attributed sales, and your ACOS is 20%

facts.fact: ROAS is the inverse of ACOS: attributed sales divided by spend
facts.quote: ROAS is simply the inverse: attributed sales divided by spend

facts.fact: TACOS (total advertising cost of sales) divides ad spend by total revenue including organic sales
facts.quote: TACOS, total advertising cost of sales, divides ad spend by TOTAL revenue including organic

facts.fact: TACOS is a better health metric for brands because it captures organic lift from advertising
facts.quote: It is the better health metric for a brand because it captures the organic lift that ads create

facts.fact: A good ACOS for most established products is under 30%
facts.quote: a good ACOS for most established products sits under 30%

facts.fact: Launch campaigns often run higher ACOS on purpose compared to established products
facts.quote: launch campaigns often run much hotter on purpose

facts.fact: Dynamic bids up and down can raise bids by up to 100% for top of search placement
facts.quote: top of search allows up to 100%

facts.fact: Dynamic bids up and down can raise bids by up to 50% for other placements
facts.quote: That cap is 50% for other placements

facts.fact: Practitioners observe only up to 50% bid boosts even for top of search placement in testing
facts.quote: we have only ever observed boosts up to 50% even on top of search

facts.fact: Recommended bidding strategy: start with dynamic down only while gathering data
facts.quote: start with dynamic down only while you gather data

facts.fact: Graduate winning campaigns to dynamic up and down bidding after data collection
facts.quote: graduate winners to up and down

facts.fact: Keep exact match keywords in separate campaigns so budget flows to proven converters
facts.quote: Keep exact match keywords in their own campaigns so budget flows to proven converters
